content: Tool result size (official docs, fetched 2026-11-27): claude.ai/Desktop ~150,000 chars; above that with code-execution sandbox active the result is written to the sandbox FS and replaced by a pointer. Claude Code: warning at 10k tokens, default max 25k tokens (MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS), text results >50,000 chars saved to a file and replaced by a path unless tool declares _meta anthropic/maxResultSizeChars (ceiling 500,000); HTTP response hard cap 16 MiB; images PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP shown inline. MCP file-transfer extension (io.modelcontextprotocol/files, beta, MCP rev 2026-07-28) is NOT available to custom connectors: requires directory listing + Anthropic-approved storage hosts. PDFs are not a tool-result content type: extract text server-side.
